name: feature-crew
description: Turns one Claude Code session into an orchestrator: features and revisions you ask for are built by background feature-builder subagents on Fable, each on its own git branch in an isolated worktree, while the main conversation stays free; a worker whose checks still fail escalates to a deeper xhigh worker before you are asked. The main session keeps a roster, relays workers' questions to you, resumes them with your answers, and reports when each one is done.
